skill.name: writing-to-logseq
skill.description: Writes pages, blocks, properties, tags, and conversation notes to Logseq DB graphs through the HTTP API.
skill.summary: Create and maintain structured Logseq graph content through authenticated API operations.
skill.author: C0ntr0lledCha0s

security_audit.summary: Most command and reconnaissance alerts are Markdown or defensive prose, so they are false positives. The script has genuine network, environment-secret, and destructive-write risks.

remediation.issue: Configured endpoints can receive bearer credentials.
remediation.suggestion: Allow only loopback Logseq URLs by default. Require explicit approval for remote HTTPS hosts before attaching credentials.

remediation.issue: Configuration can select any environment variable as a token.
remediation.suggestion: Permit only LOGSEQ_API_TOKEN interpolation. Reject other variable names and untrusted project configuration.

remediation.issue: Deletion methods do not require confirmation.
remediation.suggestion: Add dry-run output and explicit confirmation for deletions. Block recursive deletion unless the user approves it.

content.value_statement: Manual Logseq updates make note capture and structured maintenance slow. This skill creates and updates graph content through authenticated API operations.
actual_capabilities: Creates Logseq pages with initial content and properties.
Creates, updates, appends, and deletes blocks.
Adds and removes tags in block content.
Synchronizes timestamped conversation notes to namespaced pages.
Loads API settings from arguments, environment variables, or project configuration.
limitations: Requires a running Logseq HTTP API and a valid bearer token.
Write operations can alter or delete graph data.
The library does not provide transaction rollback or automatic backups.
Remote API URLs require careful trust and credential controls.

use_cases.title: Capture meeting notes
use_cases.description: Create a dated Logseq page with attendees, decisions, tasks, and structured properties.

use_cases.title: Maintain research knowledge
use_cases.description: Append findings, tags, and typed properties to existing research pages without manual graph editing.

use_cases.title: Automate daily records
use_cases.description: Sync conversation summaries and timestamped notes into namespaced Logseq pages.

prompt_templates.title: Create a simple page
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a Logseq page titled [title]. Add this content: [content]. Show the planned write before execution.

prompt_templates.title: Add structured meeting notes
prompt_templates.prompt: Create meeting notes for [date] with attendees [names], decisions [decisions], and action items [tasks]. Use clear properties and tags.

prompt_templates.title: Update an existing project page
prompt_templates.prompt: Find the Logseq page [title]. Append [update], set status to [status], and add tags [tags]. Do not replace existing content.

prompt_templates.title: Safely synchronize a conversation
prompt_templates.prompt: Summarize this conversation into [page]. Preview created blocks, properties, and links. Avoid duplicates and require approval before destructive changes.

output_examples.input: Create a project page for Atlas with status Active and three launch tasks.
output_examples.output: Created the Atlas page with an Active status property. Added three task blocks under a Launch section.

output_examples.input: Append today's decisions to Team Notes and tag the new block Decision.
output_examples.output: Appended a dated decisions block to Team Notes. Added the Decision tag without replacing existing content.
Located the requested block and prepared a deletion preview. The operation is waiting for explicit confirmation.

best_practices: Preview targets and changes before writing.
Use append and get-or-create operations when possible.
Test destructive workflows on a separate graph and keep backups.
anti_patterns: Do not send bearer tokens to untrusted or unapproved URLs.
Do not perform bulk deletions without limits and explicit confirmation.
Do not overwrite existing blocks when an append operation meets the goal.

faq.question: What does this skill need to connect?
faq.answer: It needs the Logseq HTTP API URL and a valid API bearer token.

faq.question: Can it create pages and blocks?
faq.answer: Yes. It creates pages, inserts nested or sibling blocks, and appends content.

faq.question: Can it update properties and tags?
faq.answer: Yes. It sets or removes properties and adds or removes tags from blocks.

faq.question: Can it delete graph content?
faq.answer: Yes. Deletion changes user data permanently, so review the target and confirm before execution.

faq.question: Does it back up the graph?
faq.answer: No. The library provides no backup, rollback, or transaction mechanism.

faq.question: Can it connect to a remote Logseq endpoint?
faq.answer: The URL is configurable. Only use trusted HTTPS endpoints and protect the bearer token.
